entries.subject: Disc-resolved images or interferometric imaging of WASP-18
entries.finding: The disc is about 0.1 mas across at 123 pc; no image exists. The sphere carries its Gaia colour and a model limb.
entries.revisitWhen: A reconstructed image of the star's surface is published.

entries.subject: The spin axis of WASP-18
entries.finding: Not measured in three dimensions in the sources used here; the display axis is celestial north.
entries.revisitWhen: A paper measures the stellar inclination and obliquity.
